units.source_text: 六条院源氏晚年娶朱雀院的三公主而生的薰君，

en.t: Kaoru, born to Rokujo-in Genji and Suzaku-in's Third Princess after Genji married her in his later years,

units.source_text: 冷泉院视同自己儿子一般爱护，封他为四位侍从。

en.t: was cherished by Reizei-in as though he were his own son, and was appointed Chamberlain of the Fourth Rank.

units.source_text: 薰君其时年仅十四五岁，正是天真烂漫的童年，

en.t: Kaoru was then only fourteen or fifteen, still in the innocent and carefree years of childhood,

units.source_text: 而心灵却比身体早熟，已像大人一样懂事。

en.t: yet his mind had matured ahead of his body, and he already understood things like an adult.

units.source_text: 仪容楚楚，显见前程不可限量。

en.t: His bearing was graceful and refined, clearly showing that his future promise was beyond measure.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍颇思选他为婿。

en.t: Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, was quite inclined to choose him as a son-in-law.

units.source_text: 尚侍的邸宅距三公主所居的三条院甚近，

en.t: The Naishi no Kami's residence was very near Sanjo-in, where the Third Princess lived,

units.source_text: 因此每逢邸内举办管弦之会，诸公子常去邀请薰君来家参与。

en.t: so whenever musical gatherings were held at her house, the young gentlemen often went to invite Kaoru to come and take part.

units.source_text: 尚侍邸内因有美人，青年男子无不向往，

en.t: Because there were beautiful women in the Naishi no Kami's household, every young man was drawn there,

units.source_text: 个个华装艳服，翩然出入其间。

en.t: and each of them, dressed in splendid finery, moved gracefully in and out among them.

units.source_text: 讲到相貌之秀美，则以片刻不离的藏人少将为第一；

en.t: As for beauty of appearance, the ever-present Kuroudo no Shosho ranked first;

units.source_text: 讲到性情之温存、风度之闲雅，则首推这位四位侍从。

en.t: but for gentleness of nature and quiet elegance of manner, this Chamberlain of the Fourth Rank was foremost.

units.source_text: 此外无人能与此二人并比。

en.t: Apart from these two, no one could compare with them.

units.source_text: 人都以为薰君是源氏之子，对他另眼看待。

en.t: Everyone believed Kaoru to be Genji's son, and regarded him with special favor.

units.source_text: 恐是因这缘故，他的世誉自然特盛。

en.t: Perhaps for that reason, his reputation in the world was naturally especially brilliant.

units.source_text: 青年侍女都极口称赞他。

en.t: The young ladies-in-waiting all praised him to the skies.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍也说此人的确可爱，常常亲切地和他谈话。

en.t: Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, also said that he was truly charming, and often spoke with him warmly.

units.source_text: 她说：“回思父亲大人气宇之优越，令人悼念不置，无以自慰。

en.t: She said, "When I think back on Father's surpassing dignity, my longing for him is endless, and I have no way to console myself.

units.source_text: 除了此人之外，从谁身上可以看到父亲的遗姿呢？

en.t: Apart from this young man, in whom else could I see traces of my father's presence?

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣身份太高，非有特别机会，难得和他会面。”

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, is of such high rank that unless there is some special occasion, it is hard to meet him."

units.source_text: 她把薰君看作亲兄弟一样，薰君也把她看作大姐，时来访晤。

en.t: She regarded Kaoru as though he were her own brother, and Kaoru in turn looked on her as an elder sister, visiting her from time to time.

units.source_text: 此人决不像世间一般男子那样轻薄好色，态度异常端庄稳重。

en.t: He was certainly not frivolous and amorous like ordinary men of the world; his manner was exceptionally dignified and composed.

units.source_text: 两位女公子身边的青年侍女们见他婚事未成，都替他可惜，引为憾事。

en.t: The young ladies-in-waiting serving the two young ladies saw that his marriage had not yet been settled, and all felt it was a great pity on his behalf.

units.source_text: 她们常和他开玩笑，薰君不胜烦恼。

en.t: They often teased him about it, and Kaoru found it extremely troublesome.
